page.overview:
Who is Havoc?

Lord Havoc was the host of Our Magnificent Galaxy.

Havoc hosted Our Magnificent Galaxy, in which he travelled to different planets to hunt rare creatures. On Salusa Secundus, he sought the Salusan tiger. The Harkonnen troops had spent months on the planet seeking the creature. As the creature was a master of stealth and known for its hypnotizing eyes, he approached quietly when the troops alterted them that they had located the last Salusan tiger and everything was ready for its capture. Once the creature was in sight, the soldiers shot and imprisoned it. Administering a lethal Zenobian injection, they subjected the creature to a slow and agonizing death. As it was dying, Havoc removed its many-colored eyes to keep as trophies.
